summary: Four reviewer lenses approved after concrete revisions. Planning feasibility only; no runtime candidate exists.

resolved_findings.issue: F named an unassigned regression module.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use the created unit comparator and authored integration modules.

resolved_findings.issue: S1 recording schema relied on required metadata introduced only in S3.
resolved_findings.resolution: S1 atomically owns DB/index, required metadata/constructors, format2 writer/reader and projections; S3 owns eligible collection acceptance.

resolved_findings.issue: Reset could discard a pending nonempty lane.
resolved_findings.resolution: Pre-mutation reset guard; actual shortened callers explicitly complete cap; refusal preserves all pending state.

resolved_findings.issue: Ordinary recording contains checkpoint position envelope, while deserializer and observer expect flat coordinates.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owned flat recording positions; checkpoint envelope unchanged; ordinary producer artifact loads through ReplayManager and observer.

resolved_findings.issue: Actual loss target assertions could have empty terminal/truncated subsets.
resolved_findings.resolution: Require nonzero real boundary samples/windows and original sampler/loss execution.

resolved_findings.issue: Seven-row fixture expectations could be incorrectly applied to nine recurrent warmup episodes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate seven-row ingestion from nine-episode/63-row actual learning witness.

resolved_findings.issue: Zero inactive Q placeholders could change adversarial entropy/difficulty.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retain full forward/Q interface while restoring inactive hidden rows; adversarial unequal-ending witness.

resolved_findings.issue: Shared reason module and artifact backout were unspecified.
resolved_findings.resolution: New low-level training/episode.py; restore source with fresh artifact paths, never migrate/delete newer evidence.

resolved_findings.issue: Literal task commands omitted created shared type and changed capped-loop caller.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact commands include owned creations/callers and focused gates.

resolved_findings.issue: Unchanged reward expectation could imply RND normalization cannot affect survivor reward.
resolved_findings.resolution: No-exploration recipe explicitly separated; full-population deltas require independent eligible reference and exact causal receipts.

systems.final_pass: Re-reviewed final no-exploration/RND clarification after whole-plan review.

final_revision_note: Only the systems-requested reward-attribution clarification followed the ab4b revision; systems re-approved it and coordinator checked final artifact paths/digests.
limits: No corrected runtime code or new regression tests were implemented.
Compact authored fixture, actual candidate targets/samples and ordinary recorder persistence remain execution gates.
No fresh full suite, hosted CI, convergence or recovery-exit acceptance.
